candidate_family.base: all top-12 choose-6 routes that preserve router ranks 1 and 2
candidate_family.forbidden_runtime_features: teacher logits, exact KL, expert outputs, cache outcomes
candidate_family.runtime_features: top-12 router weights, candidate rank/mask summaries, concrete expert identities, and a 32D train-only PCA projection of the current MoE input

conformal_method.guarantee_caveat: marginal exchangeability is only approximate for contiguous language tokens; empirical held-out coverage is reported
conformal_method.original_route: always allowed with structural zero risk
conformal_method.quantile: one-sided split conformal with ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)) finite-sample correction
conformal_method.score: per-token maximum over the entire candidate slate of true_log10_KL minus predicted_log10_KL

data_partition.partition_unit: contiguous token; only two 128-token validation blocks are available

payload.scope_caveat: direct layer-26 same-input full-vocabulary KL and expert-granularity LRU only; not yet a model-wide or autoregressive guarantee
